accountName.title: Account Name
accountName.description: Filter invoices by account/customer name (e.g., 'Acme Corporation'). Use this to find all invoices for a specific account.

startDate.title: Start Date
startDate.description: Start date for filtering invoices (ISO 8601). Example: '2023-01-01'.

endDate.title: End Date
endDate.description: End date for filtering invoices (ISO 8601). Example: '2023-12-31'.

search.title: Search
search.description: Search across invoice number, account name, or description.

format.title: Format
format.description: Response format: 'json' (default) or 'csv' for CSV export.
